profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
Experienced and results driven Software Engineer with over 6+ years of programming experience

Active Secret Clearance (United States Government)

480-246-7195
omarmartinez14@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Support classified programs from inception with software implementation designs, sprint planning (Agile), and overall development/technical support

• Develop various aspects of flight software using Real-time operating system such as VxWorks

• Load balanced legacy flight software to meet specified CPU utilization constraints

• Write various scripts to automate telemetry verification for various programs

• Served as scrum master for the OmegA program team and insured sprints/meetings ran smoothly (JIRA/Bitbucket)

• Write various interfaces using SpaceFibre and RS-232 to communicate between MACHs (Modular Avionic Control Hardware) and electronic devices(CEU, IMU, ECU, etc.) 

• Write comprehensive unit tests to stress and validate various aspects of code

• Experience with documenting, debugging, optimizing and peer reviewing code to ensure everything is compliant with company standards

• Expertise in writing and reviewing formal documentation outlining project scopes and requirements used for government contract bids

• Lead presentations that outline program updates at meetings between customers and partnering companies

positions.title: Intern (Developer)
positions.description:
• Created and designed user interfaces with grids and icons that allowed users to simulate waste water management and treatment techniques to ensure large scale purification across projects

• Created various user interfaces using WPF/.NET and synchronized all data across multiple windows/user controls

• Build an equation editor/custom parser for users to run custom algorithms during simulations

• Created a local storage of non-sensitive data for projects to reduce the number of queries and improve load times

• Used SQL server to store toolbox Icons, custom equations, user info, and project layout using JSON and XML

positions.title: Installed Sales Account Manager
positions.description:
• Proven success working directly with customers, manufacturers and contractors in order to provide
exceptional customer service and increase installed sales revenue for the company

• Established positive rapport with customers and built a loyal clientele

• Developed account management tools in order to more efficiently manage customer accounts

• Traveled to job sites to inspect work quality and assess repairs/damage to products or installed work

• Effective multitasker with experience in bringing multiple account projects to completion

• Experience with exploring alternative products/services in order to upsell and provide customer satisfaction

• Exceeded sales performance goals

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Summer Internship. Build Robot, Design App, Create a simple game in C#
